provenance.notes: Captured from saved classifier run 31941 (auction_lot 9886, model null, 2026-11-02T23:02:48.823Z). Production rationale: The auction listing is for a Bruichladdich Valinch 28 Chloe Wood whisky bottle. Exact-product references support a 12-year-old, 2005 single-cask release from cask 780, bottled at 48.8% ABV with an outturn of 444 and released in August 2017. No inspected local candidate represents this release: Bruichladdich 2005 Micro-Provenance Series, Bruichladdich 2005 WhB, and Port Charlotte 2005 The Distillery Valinch are distinct products. Checked 2026-11-03. Lot 184-00443 page: 'These hand-filled bottlings are available exclusively to visitors to the distillery.' Distilled 29.06.2005, 12 years old, Sauternes cask 780, 48.8%, 50cl, bottle 367/444. Owner rule (2026-10-28): distillery hand-fills, including Bruichladdich Valinch, are out of auctions and the catalog.

expected.summary: The lot page says Valinch bottlings are hand-filled and sold only to distillery visitors. A hand-fill is not a marketed release, so ignore it instead of creating a Bottle.
